subject: PivotalPay: sudden 3x latency + error spike after model upgrade — request for exec runbook
messages:
From: Ellen Moore <ellen@pivotalpay.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: tom.h@pivotalpay.com, support@pivotalpay.com
Date: 2026-03-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Production latency and errors after model upgrade — urgent

Hi Soojin,

We started seeing a big regression in production at ~08:50 PT after you flipped the new model/quant profile. Token latency has jumped ~3x on our high-volume routes and error rate (503/timeout) is spiking. This is impacting checkout flows.

Attached is a quick screenshot from our dashboard (SLOs). Can your team pause the rollout or provide a fallback immediately? We need an ETA and whether we should route traffic elsewhere.

Thanks — this is P0 for us.

— Ellen
Ellen Moore
Head of Integrations, PivotalPay
[Attachment: pivotalpay_slo_spike.png (image/png)]

Joining bridge now — quick triage notes from SE bench:
- Impact seems concentrated on the "payment/authorize" route (high token churn).
- Observed a sudden shift in sequence-length distribution after the new tokenizer handling; batching behavior changed which may expose blocking in the hot path.
- Putting SLO chart in thread (attached).

If Engineering recommends rollback, we should aim for a short maintenance window and offer a one-week credit for the impacted window. I can sync with PivotalPay on messaging.

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-03-01T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production latency and errors after model upgrade — urgent

On Mon, Mar 1, 2026 at 10:05 AM ben_carter@redwood.com wrote:
> Joining bridge now — quick triage notes from SE bench: ...

Thanks for the data. Quick findings from infra/serving side after looking at traces and pprof from the sample logs:
- The new model binary introduced a different kv-cache growth pattern during generation for certain prompt templates used by PivotalPay; this increases memory pressure and causes longer GC stalls on the host leading to token-pause spikes.
- Combined with the new packing rules in the quantized path, some requests lost the benefit of continuous batching and were scheduled as singletons. That explains the throughput drop.

Proposed immediate mitigations (orderable):
1) Temporarily pin traffic to previous model binary and qprofile (rollback) — low-risk and will restore prior latency/throughput characteristics.
2) If rollback is not acceptable, flip a runtime knob to enforce legacy packing for their tenant (per-tenant override) — quicker but longer-term patch risk.

We need leadership sign-off for the rollback window (2x GPU ops to reassign). Recommend a 30–60 minute scheduled rollback with a post-check.

I’m attaching a short playbook and logs bundle in case you want to share.

Attachments: proposed-fallback-playbook.md, pivotalpay-requested-logs.tar.gz

— Rishi Malhotra
Engineering Lead, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Laura,

This just escalated to exec level — PivotalPay is a strategic mid-market customer (DEAL-10482) with a spike in checkout impact. Engineering recommends an immediate rollback to the prior model and qprofile. Rishi estimates ~45 minutes to execute and validate.

Ask: Please approve the rollback and the proposed customer remediation (one-week pro-rated credit + a dedicated post-mortem and follow-up architecture review). We should also offer a short joint war room with their CTO if they request it.

If you approve, Soojin will confirm a 30–60 minute window with PivotalPay and Ben will own customer comms.

— Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

What we will do:
- Pin tenant routing to prior model binary + qprofile (incremental traffic shift, revert if regressions).
- Run validation harnessed traffic for 10 minutes; monitor p95/p99 latency and error-rate.
- Post-rollback follow-up: joint post-mortem, credit issuance, and a scheduled architecture review with Rishi and our serving runtime team.

Attachments included: proposed-fallback-playbook.md, pivotalpay-requested-logs.tar.gz, pivotalpay_slo_spike.png

Please confirm the rollback window or propose an alternate 1-hour window. We will stand up a governance call at 17:50 PT to run through verification steps.
